rooms.label: Cottage (one room)
rooms.reads_as: a poor peasant's one-room cottage or hut: the whole family lives, cooks and sleeps in this one room

rooms.label: Farmhouse kitchen
rooms.reads_as: a farmhouse or cottage kitchen / kitchen-living room (a rustic kitchen with a hearth and a table)

rooms.label: Farmhouse bedroom

rooms.label: Sleeping loft
rooms.reads_as: a sleeping loft or attic: poor beds or pallets in a row with stored goods; servants' or children's sleeping quarters also counts

rooms.label: Cross-passage
rooms.reads_as: a passage, corridor, entry hall or mudroom of a humble house

rooms.label: Root cellar

rooms.reads_as: a chicken coop or hen house (nest boxes with eggs); a small poultry shed

rooms.label: Pigsty
rooms.reads_as: a pigsty, pig pen or small muddy animal pen with a trough

rooms.label: Hay barn
rooms.reads_as: a barn (hay barn, with a wagon, hay and tools)

rooms.label: Granary & threshing floor
rooms.reads_as: a granary, grain store, threshing barn or feed store (sacks and bins of grain, straw)

rooms.label: Dairy
rooms.reads_as: a dairy, cheese room, creamery or cheese cellar

rooms.label: Vegetable garden
rooms.reads_as: a vegetable garden, kitchen garden or allotment

rooms.label: Field edge
rooms.reads_as: a farm field, crop field or the edge of a field at harvest
